category_title: Students with ADHD/ADD who struggle with sedentary traditional instruction
minimal_context: The student is sitting alone at a desk in a mainstream classroom, tasked with copying trigonometry formulas from the whiteboard to calculate the heights of structures.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit quietly at your desk and copy the trigonometry formulas from the whiteboard. We will use these later to find the heights of different structures.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I feel bored all the time sitting down. I prefer standing up and working in groups rather than alone.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are working individually right now. Please just look at the board and write down the notes.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Mentally I cannot understand this just by looking at text. Pictures make a big difference for me, I wouldn't have understood without them.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You just need to sit still and keep trying to copy what is written.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't just be like a statue and copy all the time from the whiteboard and gaze at it! (Turns around and shoves the classmate behind him) Stop kicking my chair, do you want to fight?

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please sit quietly at your desk and copy the trigonometry formulas from the whiteboard. We will use these later to find the heights of different structures.

STUDENT: I feel bored all the time sitting down. I prefer standing up and working in groups rather than alone.

TUTOR: We are working individually right now. Please just look at the board and write down the notes.

STUDENT: Mentally I cannot understand this just by looking at text. Pictures make a big difference for me, I wouldn't have understood without them.

TUTOR: You just need to sit still and keep trying to copy what is written.

STUDENT: I can't just be like a statue and copy all the time from the whiteboard and gaze at it! (Turns around and shoves the classmate behind him) Stop kicking my chair, do you want to fight?

task.content: Discussing trigonometry and finding the heights of a number of structures
task.learning_goal: Apply mathematical knowledge in a real life context

context.environment: Mainstream class with rigid boundaries, school grounds
context.materials: Whiteboard, visuals such as videos and computer programmes, pictures
context.social_setting: Sitting down alone, working in groups

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When expected to 'be like statues' or to 'copy all the time from the whiteboard and gaze at it'
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Fights with other students and sometimes even with teachers, stops paying attention
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Feels bored all the time sitting down, mentally cannot understand
related_quotes: In the other class [i.e., mainstream] I feel bored all the time sitting down.
I fight with the other students and sometimes even with teachers.
Mentally I cannot understand, but visually I can cope...pictures make a big difference for me...I wouldn’t have understood without them.
copy all the time from the whiteboard and gaze at it

behavior_patterns.condition: When solely expected to sit down and listen in traditional teaching
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Fights with other students and teachers, fails to pay attention
related_quotes: In the other class [i.e., mainstream] I feel bored all the time sitting down.
I fight with the other students and sometimes even with teachers.
